## Triage: raised to **`priority:p0`** · `security` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · needs a seat now · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T13:57Z

Read fresh. `AiChatPage.tsx` reads `?handoffPrompt=` from the URL and, on the build route, the build pane sends it as the signed-in user's first message with no user action (`:882`, `:1256`–`:1263`).
- Any link can therefore drive the build agent as that user.
- Through cloud's `sso-open?next=` (staging today, measured) it reaches an environment owner with no session needed.
- With `autoPublishAiBuilds` on by default in cloud environments, one click can author **and publish** metadata as the owner.

**Raised to p0.** The card itself invited this.
- The door is public (a link) and needs one click, and the outcome is an environment's metadata changed by text the attacker wrote, published as its owner. That is an integrity compromise whatever the agent's exact reach turns out to be.
- **Reach, read in this act:**
  - objectstack's console pin (`.objectui-sha` `b9814b334d`, the `18.0.0-next.1` console) carries the same auto-send;
  - so does the console of the **released `17.7.0`** (pin `0abd4f9f87`, `AiChatPage.tsx:857`).
  - Under the maintainer's 「17.x 不再发版本」, `17.7.0` installs keep it, as they keep #23586.

**Lane `domain:ui`** (`packages/app-shell`).

**Direction (triage routes it; it is not a decision card):** the card's own Wanted.
- **A URL parameter never sends a message on the user's behalf.** Carry the in-app handoff by navigation state or a same-origin store.
- If a URL parameter is kept, it **prefills only**: the composer is filled and the user presses send.
- **Pins:**
  - a page loaded with `?handoffPrompt=` sends nothing;
  - the in-app "Open in Builder →" handoff still lands its text, by state;
  - CONTROL: a user-typed first message sends as today.
- ⛔ Not a confirm dialog in front of an auto-send. The rule is that the URL never sends.

**After it lands:**
- this seat files the objectstack console pin bump (`.objectui-sha`), so the next 18 prerelease ships it;
- cloud's deploy picks it up from there.
- Whether production cloud's `autoPublishAiBuilds` default should change meanwhile is the maintainer's call. It is raised in this seat's round report.

## Review: ACCEPT (p0, security) — objectui PR #12536 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-15T15:14Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `ea7adc7`, against triage's direction (`6193858584`), the seat's ruling in the dispatch and the claim (`6193951021`), not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`. Its body opens `Fixes #12493`, the only closing keyword, followed by `Clause-②: no`. 3 files.
- **A URL parameter never sends a message (triage's rule), met:**
  - `AiChatPage` no longer reads `?handoffPrompt=`, or the companion `?parentConversationId=`, from the URL.
  - The handoff now comes from `location.state`, which only same-origin script can set. A link from anywhere, including one through cloud's `sso-open?next=`, can no longer supply it.
  - No prefill seam is kept, as the seat ruled.
- **The in-app handoff still works:** `openBuilder` (the `ask` surface's "Open in Builder →", the only producer repo-wide) navigates to `/ai/build` with `state: { handoffPrompt, parentConversationId }`, keeping only `?package=` in the URL. The click is the user's own action.
- **No re-send on reload:**
  - The seed effect is armed once per `location.key`. It stashes the prompt, then replaces the history entry with state that no longer carries `handoffPrompt`.
  - The effect is declared before the canonicalisation and URL-mirror effects, so their navigations win in a shared flush.
- **Census:** no other `console/ai/` entry turns a URL parameter into a sent message. `BuilderHandoffState` and `readBuilderHandoffState` are module-private, so the public surface is unchanged.
- **Pins:** loading with the URL parameters sends nothing; the in-app handoff sends once, through state, and carries the parent id; a reload of the same entry sends nothing; CONTROL: a typed first message sends.
- **Ablation:**
  - Restoring the URL read with the old value-keyed guard fails exactly the URL pin (1 failed, 3 passed). Restore was proven by blob hash.
  - A first leg (the URL read on the key-keyed guard) looped on replace-navigations and was voided, not counted.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`, one plain sentence.
- **Evidence:** the closure build and the app-shell type-check exit 0. `console/ai/` gives 36 files and 210 tests passed. The battery subset and changeset-fixed exit 0, and narrowed eslint shows 0 errors (warnings equal base).
- **After landing:**
  - The objectstack console pin (`.objectui-sha`) still carries the old auto-send, and so does the released `17.7.0` console. Bumping the pin so the next 18 prerelease ships this fix is triage's stated follow-up.
  - Whether production cloud's `autoPublishAiBuilds` default should change meanwhile is the maintainer's call; it is in this seat's round report.
- **Acceptance note (not filed):** `plugin-chatbot`'s `useObjectChat.ts` comment near the `parentConversationId` re-arm says the URL mirror strips "the param". The behaviour still holds; only the wording is stale.
- **CI at head:** 34 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 37 runs), all 16 test shards included.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
